why: Exit x6 (criminalCourt) needs the text that opens the civil action for damages from an offence to the victim.
Exit x6 needs the text that lets the civil action be brought with the public action before the criminal court, or separately.
Exit x6 needs the rule on the civil judge's stay until the public action is decided.
Exit x6 needs the rule on the binding choice between the civil and the criminal route.
Limitation of the civil action joined to the public action; to read around the criminal route.

Exit x5: the bankruptcy and judicial settlement chapter, to tell whether a claim against a bankrupt employer is a bankruptcy dispute for the specialised commercial court (article number from memory; the chapter is wanted).
Conflicts of jurisdiction between the ordinary and the administrative orders (the jurisdiction-conflicts tribunal); article numbers not remembered.
The regulatory text fixing the seats and areas of the specialised commercial courts, and any text fixing their installation date (law 22-13 article 13 ties the new jurisdiction to it).
